summary: Comprehensive backend testing of GestPro FastAPI app: 28/28 pytest tests passed (auth, forests, alerts, observations, drone missions, GEE mocks, predictions, stats, admin RBAC, real Claude AI). All 4 demo accounts authenticate, JWT bearer + httpOnly cookie both work, seeded data (FC Sangoué 36200 ha + FC Téné 29700 ha) confirmed, alert status history append works, drone mission auto-NDVI on terminee works, GEE mocks return 12-month series and landcover classes summing to ~100%, predictions return 64-cell grid with high_risk_zones, admin-only endpoints correctly return 403 for non-admins, admin self-delete blocked, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 returned a structured French response and was persisted to /api/ai/history.

minor.issue: Logout requires auth (Depends get_current_user). If access_token cookie/Bearer is missing or expired, logout returns 401 instead of being idempotent. Acceptable but slightly fragile for FE error states.

allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is non-compliant with CORS spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. The allow_origin_regex='.*' currently makes it work but switching to an explicit origin list is recommended for production.
No role guard – any authenticated user can update any mission. Consider restricting to pilote_drone/admin.
No role guard – any authenticated user can change status. Consider restricting to analyste_sig/admin.

action_items: Optional: tighten role guards on PATCH /api/alerts/{id}/status and PATCH /api/drone-missions/{id}.
Optional: make /api/auth/logout work without auth (idempotent) or accept invalid tokens silently.
Optional: replace CORS allow_origins='*' + allow_credentials=True with an explicit origin list for prod.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 750+ lines – consider splitting into modules (auth, alerts, gee, ai) once it grows further.
require_roles always allows admin via short-circuit; behaviour is correct but not obvious from signature.
ai_analyze stores raw user input and full LLM response without size limit – consider truncation/quota.
secure=True + samesite='none' cookie requires HTTPS – fine for prod (preview is HTTPS), but local dev over http will break cookie auth (Bearer token still works).
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed (admin + 3 demo users + 2 forests + ~14 alerts + ~8 observations + ~6 drone missions). Test rows created with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up where applicable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. If frontend testing is requested next, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://geefastapi.preview.emergentagent.com. JWT is delivered both as httpOnly cookie (samesite=none, secure) and access_token in JSON. Use Bearer header for any API automation. Forest IDs are seeded once; fetch via GET /api/forests. Claude /api/ai/analyze takes ~10–25s.
